history.title: SS Patrick Henry

culture.text: Rachel Carson's book Silent Spring is published, inspiring an environmental movement and the creation of the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency.
culture.title: Silent Spring
culture.description: Book by Rachel Carson about pesticides harming the environment
